subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
A dime a dozen

options.text: To be in a difficult situation

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Very common.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"a dime a dozen"** means something that is very common and not special. (बहुत आम)
 
 
• **Example: **In the city, coffee shops are a dime a dozen; you can find one on almost every corner.
 
 
 
• **"Very rare"** refers to something that is not common and is hard to find. (बहुत दुर्लभ)
 
 
• **Example: **Finding a four-leaf clover is very rare.
